name: Zeph
source:
The protagonist.

Zeph was a human before he became an angel.
Even though he has no recollection of his time on Earth, he's very found of humans and is eager to regain his memories.

Zeph is naive and innocent.
He's very easy to take adventage of.

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/our-fate-forsaken]itch.io[/url]]
